$comment: BIOLOG data classification registry. Owner: Kemi. Source of truth for ADR-0003 Decision 3. Examples are SYNTHETIC.

rules.secrets_are_absent_not_redacted: A secret value is never copied into an envelope in any form. Its field NAME may appear in withheld[].
rules.allowlist_not_denylist: Envelopes are built by projecting through an explicit allowlist. A denylist fails open on every field added later, and the caller controls field names.
rules.no_hashing_low_entropy: A hash of a date of birth, national identifier, staff number or phone number is reversible by enumeration. It is pseudonymisation, not redaction, and may not be published as redaction.
rules.classification_is_the_maximum: An envelope's classification is the highest level of anything it names, so a consumer can make a retention or export decision from the envelope alone.
